source_text: Qui in secundo numero scribuntur, hi hereditatem terrae sanctae capiunt. Gloria Christo in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Who in second number are-written, these inheritance of-land holy seize. Glory to-Christ into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: Those written in the second number take the holy land’s inheritance. Glory to Christ forever. Amen.
